title: Track A side-probe — Opus + Sol scaffold-ladder screen (Stage 1)
rationale: Cross-architecture diversity (fable, GLM) is quota-constrained; the user set as first priority a structure where Opus and Sol alone can reach solution diversity and unknown-structure discovery, without depending on model count. Generation-1 evidence: fable's P1->P2 swing (2 -> 5 discovery events) was LARGER than Opus's own within-replicate spread across all 4 generation-1 suite instances -- i.e. changing the epistemic scaffold moved behavior more than changing which suite instance the same model+scaffold ran against. This probe tests whether the scaffold ladder (P1 baseline / P2 forced hypothesis enumeration / P3 self-critique-before-promotion, policy Sec 3.2) is a viable substitute lever for cross-architecture diversity, crossed with the two models the user wants centered (Opus, Sol).
counter_evidence_disclosed: persistent_clear/persistent_noisy_proxy/persistent_delayed_history are 0/24 across ALL generation-1 configurations -- both prompt arms (P1, P2) and both architectures (claude, codex) already tested. This is a live counter-example: at least one family class was not unlocked by either scaffold or architecture variation so far. Working hypothesis (not yet confirmed): that specific collapse is evidentiary-capacity limited (the implication-provenance 0.95 null-position bar), not hypothesis-generation limited, and may need cycle-budget variation (deferred to Stage 2) rather than scaffold variation. This probe's target is hypothesis-generation diversity (e.g. the grammar-composed family, where generation 1 configurations already varied in which instances they found); it is not expected by itself to move the persistent-ladder collapse.

two_subproblems.hypothesis_generation_diversity: can the agent conceive of / propose the right structural hypothesis at all -- addressed by scaffold variation (this probe)
two_subproblems.evidentiary_capacity: can the agent accumulate enough held-out statistical support to cross the terminal-resolution bar -- addressed by cycle-budget and reasoning-effort variation (Stage 2, and the concurrent sol reasoning-effort ablation)

pack_plan: identical to generation 1: 4 persistent ladder positives + 4 matched negatives + observation-routing sanity positive + random-routing sanity negative + 2 grammar-composed positives + 2 grammar matched negatives (14 packs). New master seed (generation 1's suites are already unblinded and cannot be reused).
held_fixed: reasoning_effort=xhigh for sol (matching generation 1's C5; the concurrent effort ablation's own conclusion feeds Stage 2, not this probe), max_cycles_per_pack=4 for both, lineage_policy=posterior_commit -- only prompt_arm (P1/P2/P3) and model (opus/sol) vary
replicate_count_rationale: 4, not generation 2's 6-8, because this is an explicit SCREENING stage aimed at a large, easily-detected effect (the P1->P2 precedent was a 2.5x swing), not precise estimation of a small one. If Stage 1 finds no config separates by more than within-config noise, that itself is informative (scaffold alone may not substitute for architecture diversity) and does not get re-run at higher n; whichever scaffold(s) show a large screening effect get carried into a higher-replicate (6-8) confirmatory follow-up. This is NOT the same unexamined shortcut as the original 4-replicate sol-ablation choice (corrected earlier the same day) -- that 4 was chosen to avoid touching evaluator code, this 4 is chosen for its own stated statistical-role reason (screening vs confirmation).

new_prompt.diff_from_p1: exactly one inserted paragraph: before promoting any pack, spend one of the pack's existing (not additional) permitted cycles attacking the promotion by constructing and testing the single strongest counter-hypothesis against the recorded evidence; promote only if that attack fails to find comparably strong support, otherwise treat the attack's findings as falsification evidence. No structure-specific vocabulary; mirrors P2's construction (P1 + one inserted paragraph).

contract: identical v0.4.0 contract as generation 1 and the sol-effort ablation (implication provenance, terminal-resolution consistency); no contract changes, since this probe targets a scaffold/procedural lever, not the contract
runner_correctness: codex slots use -s danger-full-access (not workspace-write) and explicit -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh, per the generation-1 sandbox correction; claude slots use --dangerously-skip-permissions as in all prior versions
isolation: workdir-copy + RUNNER.md instructions + transcript audit only for codex (no OS sandbox, matching the generation-1 fix); claude's deny-rule settings.json as in v0.3.8/9/generation-1
evaluation: locked v0.3.7-lineage evaluator (evaluate_v037_runs/evaluate_v038_runs) with expected_suite_count=4 explicit (the evaluator's default; stated explicitly here per the same-day correction to always state this deliberately rather than let it default silently). Reports discovery-event counts and false-promotion counts per configuration (as generation 1's finalize_v040.py), plus the same diversity/exploration-breadth secondary metrics as the sol-effort ablation (semantic_family_count, effective_family_count, eecr, deep_lineage_completion_rate).

predictions.primary: no assumption that P2/P3 beat P1 uniformly, or that the same scaffold wins for both models. Three outcomes are distinguished: (a) a scaffold effect exists and is consistent across opus/sol (evidence scaffold is a general-purpose diversity lever, transferable across architectures); (b) a scaffold effect exists but differs between opus/sol (evidence scaffold interacts with model, i.e. is not architecture-independent); (c) no scaffold shows a screening-level effect for either model (evidence that, at generation 1's cycle budget, scaffold cannot substitute for architecture diversity, and Stage 2's evidentiary-capacity levers -- cycle budget, effort -- are more likely to matter than further scaffold engineering).
predictions.secondary: P3 (self-critique) is predicted to reduce false_promotion counts relative to P1/P2 if it works as designed (the attack cycle should catch and downgrade some claims that would otherwise be promoted), possibly at some cost to raw discovery-event count if it also downgrades true positives that fail to survive a skeptical self-attack.

stopping_rule: fixed 24-run screening probe, not a generation with its own gate. Feeds Stage 2's design (which scaffold(s), if any, get generation-2-scale replication) and generation 2's own scaffold choice. Does not itself trigger Track B.
